verdict.rationale: SerpApi's Google Search API docs say you can use any regular Google search operator in the query, explicitly naming `site:`, which lets developers restrict results to a domain. This is a passthrough workaround in the query string, not a dedicated domain-filter control, and exclusion is only implied. Missing for 10: a dedicated include/exclude domain parameter, explicit documentation of domain exclusion (e.g. `-site:`), coverage across non-Google engines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
